root_cause_criterion.criterion: Once `elf_sym_by_idx()` returns a relocation symbol, `bpf_object__collect_prog_relos()` must reject any symbol whose `st_shndx` is not strictly below `obj->efile.sec_cnt` before later relocation processing can reuse that field as a section-table index.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable program trusts `sym->st_shndx` after only checking that the symbol entry exists. The fixed program adds the missing `sym->st_shndx >= obj->efile.sec_cnt` rejection at this lookup site, preventing the bogus section index from reaching `bpf_program__record_reloc()` and the later section-table switch.

nodes.state: `bpf_object__section_to_libbpf_map_type()` reaches its `switch (obj->efile.secs[shndx].sec_type)` with `shndx >= obj->efile.sec_cnt`, so the section-table read is out of bounds.

The existing special-section guard only rejects `!shdr_idx || shdr_idx >= SHN_LORESERVE`; the witnessed bad index still satisfies `shdr_idx < SHN_LORESERVE`, so control falls through toward map-type resolution.

edges.relation: The unchecked section index fetched from the relocation symbol is copied into local `shdr_idx` unchanged before the existing special-section guard evaluates it.
After the weak special-section guard falls through, the same section index is passed as `shndx` into `bpf_object__section_to_libbpf_map_type()` and drives the out-of-bounds section-table read.
